change_policy: Change this semantic contract for any numerical, availability, null, quality, clock, or halt-behavior change. Optimized implementations must pass exact reference equivalence.
midpoint_integration: Exact binary64 midpoint times integer nanosecond duration, summed in fixed-point units of 2^-1074 dollars-ns; one rounding of the final supported mean. Same-price refresh partition invariant; no movement epsilon.

reference_implementation.age_statistic: linear p90 of valid endpoint ages, milliseconds
reference_implementation.historical_overlay: not live-reproducible without point-in-time halt status
reference_implementation.nbbo_state_change: inherited price/size/exchange/validity signature, not price/size changes only
